name: Mythos Gates: Ascension Combat System
designPillar: Avatar Power Fantasy: The player controls a divine Avatar — a projection of their chosen Deity — carving through many enemies with readable, spectacular combat.
corePrinciples: Player controls ONE deity at a time in real-time combat
Face waves of enemies, elite foes, and boss encounters
Combat is weighty, divine, and spectacular but visually readable
Mobile-first controls: TAP-TO-MOVE + ability buttons + dodge dash. NO joystick. One-hand playable.
Tactical clarity: strong silhouettes, readable telegraphs, clear AoE markers
Each deity has a distinct combat identity, element, and playstyle
MOBA-lite feel (Arena of Valor / Wild Rift simplified) with god-scale combat

controls.movement: TAP-TO-MOVE — tap anywhere on the battlefield and the avatar walks to that location. No joystick. No auto-pathing to enemies. Positioning is a deliberate strategic choice.
controls.basicAttack: AUTO — basic attacks trigger automatically when an enemy is within weapon range. No input needed. Free. 3-4 hit combo chain with unique properties per deity.
controls.ability1: Tap button — short cooldown (5-8s), tactical use. Tap when charged/off cooldown.
controls.ability2: Tap button — medium cooldown (8-12s), stronger effect. Tap when charged/off cooldown.
controls.signature: Tap button — long cooldown (15-20s), big impact. Tap when charged/off cooldown.
controls.ultimate: Tap button — requires 100% Belief bar. Tap to unleash. Screen-wide effect.
controls.dodge: Tap button — quick dash reposition. NOT a timing window. NOT i-frames. Spatial awareness counter — use to escape hazard zones, close distance, or reposition strategically. Short cooldown (3-5s).

controlSummary.dodgeType: Spatial reposition dash — NOT timing-based, NOT i-frames

resources.divineEnergy: Built from basic attacks and taking damage. Spent on abilities 1, 2, and Signature.
resources.beliefBar: Built throughout the battle from all combat actions. At 100%, Ultimate/Ascension is unlocked. Replaces the old Ascension Gauge.
resources.factionResource: Each faction has a unique resource (Solar Charge, Oath Fury, Divine Glory, etc.) that powers the deity's passive ability.

abilityKit.basicAttack: No cooldown. Automatic when enemy in range. Builds Divine Energy. Unique per deity. 3-4 hit combo chain with unique properties.
abilityKit.ability1: Short cooldown (5-8s). Low Divine Energy cost (20-30). Tactical ability — mobility, CC, shield, or buff.
abilityKit.ability2: Medium cooldown (8-12s). Medium Divine Energy cost (35-45). Stronger ability — AoE, heavy damage, or sustain.
abilityKit.signature: Long cooldown (15-20s). High Divine Energy cost (65-75). Signature divine skill — the deity's mythic power unleashed.
abilityKit.ultimate: Requires 100% Belief bar. Screen-wide effect — every enemy on the battlefield takes the hit. Each deity has a unique ultimate. Cinematic.
abilityKit.passive: Always active. Builds faction resource from combat actions. At threshold, empowers next ability or attack.

dodgeParrySystem.description: Dodge and parry as DAMAGE MITIGATION are auto-resolved stat checks, not player inputs. The dodge BUTTON is for SPATIAL REPOSITIONING only (quick dash), not for timing-based invincibility.
howItWorks: 1. Enemy attacks -> Game rolls Avatar Dodge Stat vs Enemy Accuracy Stat
2. If Dodge succeeds -> Avatar auto-evades (dodge animation plays)
3. If Dodge fails -> Game rolls Avatar Parry Stat vs Enemy Attack Power
4. If Parry succeeds -> Reduced damage taken (parry animation plays)
5. If both fail -> Full damage taken

statProfiles.highDodge: Agile, evasive playstyle — avatar auto-evades frequently
statProfiles.highParry: Tanky, defensive playstyle — reduces damage when hit
statProfiles.lowBoth: Glass cannon — takes full hits but deals high damage

dodgeParrySystem.dodgeButton: Separate from stat dodge/parry. The dodge button is a quick dash for spatial repositioning — escape hazard zones, close distance, reposition for abilities. Short cooldown (3-5s). No i-frames, no timing window.

groundEffectZones.description: The flat combat plane contains interactive zones with gameplay effects. Zone layouts are unique per battlefield based on faction terrain.

zoneTypes.damageZones: Void-mist pools, fire fields, energy burns — deal damage over time
zoneTypes.buffZones: Faction-aligned power spots — increase damage, defense, or ability charge speed
zoneTypes.debuffZones: Slow fields, weaken areas — reduce enemy effectiveness
zoneTypes.hazardZones: Instant damage if occupied too long — forces repositioning

factionZones.Aten Ra: Solar burn zones, sandstorm blind areas
factionZones.Asgardian: Storm surge zones, ice slick areas
factionZones.Olympian: Divine light buff zones, earthquake cracks
factionZones.Kami: Spirit energy zones, sakura bloom buffs
factionZones.Empyrean: Radiant light zones, holy ground buffs
factionZones.Hollow: Void-mist dissolution zones, anti-light hazard fields

attackRangeSystem.description: Each weapon has a Range Stat. Auto-attack only triggers when enemy is within weapon range. If no enemy in range, avatar stands idle (player must reposition via tap-to-move).

ranges.melee: Short range — must be close to auto-attack
ranges.bow_spell: Long range — can auto-attack from far away

abilityTypes.cleave: Hits enemies in a front arc
abilityTypes.aoe: Hits all enemies within a radius
abilityTypes.line: Hits everything in a straight line
abilityTypes.ultimate: Hits ALL enemies on the battlefield — screen-wide

playerDecisions: WHERE to stand — ground effect zones make positioning critical
WHEN to use abilities — charge/cooldown management + enemy positioning
HOW to build the avatar — stats, gear, belief path (dodge vs parry vs damage)
WHEN to pop ultimate — Belief bar timing, maximizing enemy hits
WHEN to dash — dodge button for spatial repositioning (escape zones, close gaps, reposition)

enemyDesign.waves: Trash mobs — easily killed by basic attacks, come in groups of 5-15
enemyDesign.elites: Tougher enemies with special abilities — require ability usage, come in pairs or small groups
enemyDesign.bosses: Divine trials, gate guardians, corrupted gods — require full ability rotation and strategic positioning
enemyDesign.hollow: Hollow-corrupted variants of realm enemies — twisted, dangerous, destabilized

enemyAI.philosophy: Hollow enemies are tactical opponents that understand the battlefield, player abilities, and ground effect system. Creates emergent, chess-like encounters.
enemyAI.terrainAwareness: Enemies exploit buff zones, deny player buff zones, bait toward hazards, use cover, ambush from debuff zones
enemyAI.combatIntelligence: Enemies track cooldowns, detect Belief bar charging, exploit range, profile player weaknesses, reposition strategically

archetypes.Stalker: Flanks and strikes from behind — Assassin
archetypes.Brute: Charges through hazards, creates new hazard zones — Tank/Zone Controller
archetypes.Caster: Stands in buff zones at range, kites if approached — Ranged DPS
archetypes.Swarmer: Groups in debuff zones to slow player, overwhelms with numbers — Crowd Control
archetypes.Sentinel: Guards key positions, won't chase, forces approach into unfavorable zones — Defender

enemyAI.zoneManipulation: Advanced enemies can create, corrupt, displace, or clear ground effect zones
enemyAI.coordinatedTactics: Late-game enemies coordinate via pincer, zone traps, ultimate denial, divide-and-conquer

combatFantasy: One legendary god-like deity enters enemy-controlled territory alone, fights through many coordinated enemies, grows visibly stronger, and eventually destroys forces that once seemed impossible.
mobileReadability: Strong silhouettes, clear telegraph lines for enemy attacks, obvious AoE markers on the ground, large touch targets for ability buttons, readable health bars and cooldown indicators.

avatar_system.deity_status: Safe in home Realm — never dies
avatar_system.scale: God-scale everywhere — avatars tower over environment

Warrior.name: Warrior — The Unbroken
Warrior.trigger: Win while staying above 50% HP the entire fight
Warrior.description: The Avatar's composure under pressure is absolute. Rewards sustained presence and tank discipline.

Caster.name: Caster — The Weaver
Caster.trigger: Win after executing 3+ ability combo chains in one encounter
Caster.description: The Avatar channels divine energy through complex ability rotations. Rewards ability mastery and resource management.

Archer.name: Archer — The Sovereign
Archer.trigger: Win while controlling 60%+ of battlefield nodes
Archer.description: The Avatar commands the battlefield from range. Rewards spatial control and positioning.

Assassin.name: Assassin — The Breaker
Assassin.trigger: Win after breaking 3+ enemy armor/defense stacks
Assassin.description: The Avatar shatters enemy defenses with precise, devastating strikes. Rewards aggressive offense and burst timing.

balance_note: All 28 deities use 4 combat roles (Warrior, Caster, Archer, Assassin). Each deity has one faith trigger matching their role. Optimal play = 130 Belief/win, standard = 115/win. ~13% gap.

battlefieldArchitecture.planeType: 2.5D — flat combat plane with 3D terrain for visual depth
battlefieldArchitecture.cameraAngle: ~30-degree overhead angle — flat enough for tactical clarity, angled enough to sell 3D depth
battlefieldArchitecture.scale: Tiny human-sized buildings and structures scattered to show god-scale combat (avatars tower over everything)
battlefieldArchitecture.noAutoMove: Player manually taps to reposition. No auto-pathing to enemies.

changeLog: v1.0.0 — Initial turn-based tactical combat system
v2.0.0 — Reworked to real-time action RPG with virtual joystick + swipe dodge with i-frames
v2.1.0 (Aug 19 2026) — Removed joystick, switched to tap-to-move. Dodge/parry became auto-resolved stat checks. No reflex inputs.

v3.0.0 (Aug 20 2026) — FINAL: Tap-to-move + auto basic attacks + 3-4 ability buttons + 1 dodge button (spatial dash, NOT timing-based). Dodge button is for repositioning only. Stat-driven dodge/parry still auto-resolved for damage mitigation. Total 4-5 buttons. Zero joysticks. One-hand playable. MOBA-lite feel.
